proposed_widenings.name: grant_environmental_temperature_immunity
proposed_widenings.justification: The passive damage-reduction rider fits today, but the item also grants deterministic immunity to extreme cold exposure for the wearer and carried/worn gear. That mechanic is neither damage resistance nor damage immunity to a typed attack/source, and the current surface has no atom for environmental temperature protection.
proposed_widenings.evidence: while wearing this ring, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower

notes: Authored the supported subset as a passive magic item with a wearing-item gate and `reduce_damage_taken` vs cold. Typecheck and tracer both passed. The environmental-temperature rider is omitted from the authored content and recorded here as the widening.
